title.rendered: This game-sealing play was sparked by bond between Dolphins coach Hafley, players

excerpt.rendered: When Miami Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley made the call for the decisive play in his first win, he leaned on his players to make the decision.

title.rendered: Dolphins’ Kadyn Proctor out vs. Patriots; CB JuJu Brents advances in concussion protocol

excerpt.rendered: The Miami Dolphins don’t seem like they’ll have Kadyn Proctor in Sunday’s game against the Patriots, but JuJu Brents continues to improve his chances to play.
